expected_stats._comment: Checked by tests/test_dataset_stats.py. Source (2026-11-04): question_metadata.parquet, question_image_metadata.parquet and patient_metadata.parquet of the export exports/A_frontal/metadata/q1M, read with pandas. The README gives 1M questions for q1M, and the files have 1,000,000. The table has one row per question, so rows is the question count (D-03). As the harmonizer does, the pandas code keeps one image for each question (the first image_id after a sort) and takes the split of each patient from patient_metadata.parquet. Then the 3 splits have 979,811 (train), 7,620 (validate) and 12,569 (test) questions. Each study then has one image, so images equals studies. No patient is in 2 splits. The train key is not here: one harmonize() of train opens 203,825 studies in qa.zip and took 1,796 s (30 minutes) on 2026-11-04. That run gave the same counts as pandas: 979,811 rows, 203,825 images, 203,825 studies and 62,200 patients.
